cases.derivation: Hand derivation. Pillars: 1981 is a Xin-You year; the Zi month of a Xin year starts with Geng (five-tiger rule: Bing/Xin years start Bing at Yin, so Zi month stem is Geng); 1981-12-21 is a Gui-You day; a Gui day's Zi hour stem is Ren (five-rat rule: Jia/Ji start Jia at Zi, Gui is the 5th step -> Ren at Zi). Day master Gui (water). Month gate: Zi principal qi is Gui (reviewed), relation same_element -> reviewed_same_element_month_zi true. Support-only: visible stems Xin (year, metal generates water = resource), Geng (month, resource), Ren (hour, same element = peer) are all support; hidden stems are Zi [Gui] and You [Xin] only, both support -> all_positions_support_only true; resource visible (Xin/Geng) and peer visible (Ren) both true. Roots: Gui roots at month Zi and hour Zi (hidden Gui); S1 register grades Gui@Zi per_stem_listed (Lu position, explicit per-stem statement), no root-type source conflict on either fact, no branch interaction touches Zi or You (no Mao/Chen/Hai partner; Zi-You is not an unresolved kind) -> effective_day_roots_registered true. Visible roots: Xin has You (per-stem listed), Geng has You (framework heavy), Gui has Zi -> all_visible_have_registered_roots true. No unresolved interactions -> all eight water conditions true. The sealed availability variant is wood-scoped and reports both roots out-of-scope; under the register criterion both are effective, so the reconciled blocker list is empty -> strong via pure_generating_support_water (Congwang/Congqiang element-generic definitions), sufficient_rule null, registration pending. month_root_grade per_stem_listed; root_grades [(month, Zi, Gui, per_stem_listed), (hour, Zi, Gui, per_stem_listed)].

Hand derivation. 1921 is a Xin-You year, Zi month stem Geng as in the positive case; 1921-12-15 is a Ren-Zi day; a Ren day's Zi hour stem is Geng (five-rat rule: Ding/Ren days start Geng at Zi). Day master Ren (water). Seven of eight water conditions hold: month gate true (Zi, same_element); support-only true (visible Xin/Geng are resource; hidden Zi [Gui], You [Xin] all support); resource visible true; roots at month/day/hour Zi (hidden Gui) -- S1 grades Ren@Zi framework_derived (Di-wang by framework derivation from the twelve-stage cycle, never an explicit statement), no conflicts, no interactions -> effective true; all visible stems have registered roots (Xin@You listed, Geng@You framework) -> true; no unresolved interactions -> true. The single failing condition is visible peer: the visible stems are Xin, Geng, Geng -- no water stem is visible, and the day stem itself never counts as a visible peer. This witnesses the no-peer-source face of the registered Ren unsatisfiability (WATER_ZI_SATISFIABILITY.ren_unrealizable, channel 2): the full enumeration there shows a visible water stem on a Ren chart forces either a fire/control stem into the visible layer, a drain month stem, or an hour stem (Geng) with no root position anywhere in the chart. Verdict must stay indeterminate with the water scope table showing exactly one false condition.

Hand derivation. 1981 Xin-You year (before the 1982 Lichun), Chou month of a Xin year starts Xin (five-tiger: Bing/Xin start Bing at Yin -> Chou month stem Xin); 1982-01-29 is a Ren-Zi day; Ren day Zi hour is Geng. Day master Ren. Month gate fails by one branch: month is Chou, not Zi (Chou is a storehouse branch whose principal relation is not_reviewed in the sealed layer). Support-only also fails (Chou hides Ji earth = control and Xin; the day/hour Zi and year You are support, but Chou's Ji breaks it). Visible peer fails (visible Xin/Xin/Geng, no water stem). Effective-roots fails: the Ren root at month Chou (hidden Gui) is graded light_listed_conflicted in S1 (Chou lists Gui as a root in one review set and as tomb/residue in the other) and its executed fact carries a root-type source conflict plus the Zi-Chou harmony touching it. all_visible_have_registered_roots stays true (Xin@You listed, Geng@You framework; the Chou position of Geng via hidden Xin is not needed). no_unresolved_interactions fails (Zi-Chou six-harmony). Five conditions false, three true (water_day_master, visible resource via Xin/Geng, all_visible) -> indeterminate, and a root_type_source_conflict check must be present.

Hand derivation. Same year/month/day as the Gui positive case; the Hai hour of a Gui day is Gui (five-rat rule: Gui day Hai hour stem is Gui). Day master Gui. The chart differs from the positive case only in the hour pillar. It adds a third day root: hour Hai hides Ren, a structural Gui root whose S1 cell Gui@Hai is conflicted_pending under the registered branch sanming-juan2.gui-changsheng (the Gui Changsheng position is Mao under Sanming Tonghui juan 1 vs Shen under the Ditiansui-lineage quotation; Hai is a root only under the Shen branch, as the Yu-qi of Shen). The executed root fact itself carries NO fact-level conflict flag, so this case isolates the register-driven presentation: the bounded assessment must present a root_type_source_conflict check with conflict_id sanming-juan2.gui-changsheng at the hour root and block on it. Support-only also fails (Hai hides Jia wood = drain). All other conditions true (month gate, resource Xin/Geng visible, peer Gui visible at hour, all visible stems rooted, no unresolved interactions -- Hai has no clash/harmony/harm partner among You/Zi/You). effective_day_roots_registered false because not every day root is register-effective. Verdict indeterminate; the pending cell never passes.

Hand derivation. Same year/month/day as the Gui positive case; the Chou hour of a Gui day is Gui (five-rat rule). Day master Gui. The hour root (Chou, hidden Gui) is graded light_listed_conflicted in S1: Chou appears in the Sanming heavy-root list for Gui and simultaneously as Gui's tomb (Mu) in the twelve-stage table, and the Ditiansui Ren-commentary residue list also names Chou -- the root-type readings conflict (bazi.concept.conflict_root_type_readings). The executed fact for this root carries a root-type source conflict of the same ID, so fact-level and register-level agree (the register re-presentation is suppressed by the elif ordering to avoid double presentation). Support-only fails (Chou hides Ji earth = control). no_unresolved_interactions fails (Zi-Chou six-harmony). Month gate, resource, peer (hour Gui visible), all-visible-roots all true; effective_day_roots_registered false. Verdict indeterminate with exactly one root_type_source_conflict check (no duplicate).

Hand derivation. 1981 Xin-You year; You month of a Xin year starts Ding (five-tiger rule); 1981-09-10 is a Xin-Mao day; a Xin day's Zi hour stem is Wu (five-rat rule: Bing/Xin days start Wu at Zi). Day master Xin (metal). Month gate TRUE: You principal qi Xin is reviewed, relation same_element -- this is the S1 double-attested month-root fact (Xin Lu at You), not branch-dependent. The form still fails on five conditions: support-only false (visible Ding fire controls metal; Mao hides Yi wealth; Zi hides Gui drain); effective roots false -- both day roots (year You and month You, hidden Xin, S1 grade per_stem_listed) are touched by the Mao-You six-clash, so neither is register-effective; all-visible-roots false -- visible Ding (fire) has no root position among You/You/Mao/Zi (no branch hides a fire stem except none; Mao/Zi/You hide Yi/Gui/Xin), so Ding has no registered root; no_unresolved_interactions false (Mao-You clash). Resource visible true (hour Wu earth), peer visible true (year Xin). Verdict indeterminate; the metal predicate must not fire even with the month gate satisfied.

Hand derivation. 1981 Xin-You year, You month stem Ding (five-tiger rule); 1981-09-09 is a Geng-Yin day; a Geng day's Zi hour stem is Bing (five-rat rule: Yi/Geng days start Bing at Zi). Day master Geng (metal). Month gate true (You, same_element; Geng@You is the framework_derived Di-wang heavy root). Day roots are exactly two: year You and month You (hidden Xin), both framework heavy with no conflict and no branch relation, so effective_day_roots_registered is TRUE -- note Yin does NOT hide Geng (Yin hides Jia/Bing/Wu), so there is no day root at Yin at all, consistent with the register's no_root grade for Geng@Yin. Support-only false (visible Ding and Bing are fire = control; Yin hides Jia wealth and Bing; Zi hides Gui drain). Resource visible false (no earth stem visible). Peer visible true (year Xin). All-visible-roots false: visible Ding and Bing each have a root position only at the day Yin (via hidden Bing), and fire has no reviewed root-branch set in the sealed policy and no S1 register table, so neither fire stem has a registered root position (Xin is rooted at You, per-stem listed). No-unresolved-interactions false: the year stem Xin and hour stem Bing form a stem five-combination (Bing-Xin), an unresolved interaction kind. Verdict indeterminate: six conditions true/false pattern {day true, month true, support false, resource false, peer true, effective true, all-visible false, interactions false}.

Hand derivation (E0355 positive, Wu/Ji whitelist). 1928 Wu-Chen year, Wu-Wu month (five-tiger), 1928-06-10 is a Xin-Si day, a Xin day's Chou hour stem is Ji (five-rat). Day master Xin (metal). Month gate false (Wu, not You). Support-only false: Chen hides Yi (wealth), Wu hides Ding (control). Resource visible true (all three visible stems are earth); peer visible false (no metal visible stem). Day roots: Xin's only root position is Chou (hour), graded light_listed_conflicted in the S1 register, never register-effective -- false. All-visible-roots TRUE, and only through the E0257 contract whitelist wired at E0355: a visible stem's root positions are the chart's same-element root presences, so both earth stems see position branches {Chen, Wu, Si, Chou}. For Wu the cells are Chen (structural_present_ungraded), Wu (conflicted_pending), Si (per-stem-listed Lu -- counts) and Chou (ungraded); for Ji they are Chen (ungraded), Wu (per-stem-listed Lu -- counts), Si (conflicted_pending) and Chou (ungraded). Before the wiring this condition was false. No-unresolved-interactions false (Chou-Wu six-harm). The form does not fire; verdict indeterminate.

Hand derivation (E0355 ungraded-blocked). 1924 Jia-Zi year, Wu-Chen month (five-tiger: Jia year Chen month starts Wu), 1924-04-12 is a Xin-You day, a Xin day's Mao hour stem is Xin (five-rat). task: TJ-011.2 S2 (pure-support extension to metal x You / water x Zi)

unrealizable.factor_level_note: Factor-layer tests (synthetic factor inputs, explicitly labelled factor-level, following the commanding batch FactorLayerTests precedent) show the metal scope evaluating all-true and each single-condition failure flipping the outcome; they are not real-chart evidence.
unrealizable.proof_summary: Three independent channels. (1) Hidden-stem layer: branches whose hidden stems all lie in {earth, metal} (the support set for a metal day master) -- only You (single hidden stem Xin) qualifies; Chou hides Gui (drain), Xu hides Ding (control), Chen hides Yi (wealth) and Gui, Si hides Bing, Shen hides Ren (drain), Hai hides Jia (wealth), Wu/Wei hide Ding, Yin hides Jia/Bing, Mao hides Yi, Zi hides Gui. So all_positions_support_only forces all four branches to You. (2) Visible layer on all-You charts: year stem in {Ji, Xin, Gui, Ding, Yi} with You-month stem forced by the five-tiger rule to (Ji->Gui, Xin->Ding, Gui->Xin, Ding->Ji, Yi->Yi); every (year, month) pair contains a non-support stem; a Geng-You day pillar does not exist (stem-branch parity), and a Xin day's You hour stem is Ding (control). (3) Register gap (independent of 1-2): the metal form's resource is earth, and earth stems have no settled root set in the sealed policy or the S1 register (earth roots unregistered), so visible-resource and all-visible-roots cannot hold simultaneously under the current register surface. Channels 1-2 are calendrical facts; channel 3 is a register/policy gap that must be re-checked if earth root positions are ever adjudicated. The predicate is implemented exactly as registered and its evaluation logic is covered at factor level; no real chart can satisfy it, and this entry -- not a fabricated chart -- is the metal positive coverage.

unrealizable.factor_level_note: The Ren scope evaluation logic is covered by the same factor-layer baseline as Gui (the scope is element-keyed, not stem-keyed); the unrealizability is a calendrical fact about real charts, registered here.
unrealizable.proof_summary: Gui is satisfiable (witness case tj0112-s2-water-positive-gui); Ren is not. (1) Branches whose hidden stems all lie in {water, metal}: only Zi (single Gui) and You (single Xin); a Ren-You day pillar does not exist (parity), so the day pillar is Ren-Zi. (2) A visible peer (water stem) cannot coexist with the remaining conditions. A Ren month stem requires a Ding or Ren year stem (five-tiger Ding/Ren family): a Ding year stem is fire (control) and breaks support-only itself; a Ren year stem forces the year pillar Ren-Zi (the only Ren pillar with branch in {Zi, You}), month stem Ren, day Ren-Zi, and an hour stem on Zi/You of Geng or Ji -- Ji is earth (control), and Geng, while resource, has no root position in an all-Zi chart (no branch hides a metal stem; every metal-hiding branch carries a control/drain/wealth hidden stem and is excluded by channel 1, and no Ren-You pillar exists), so all_visible_have_registered_roots fails. A Gui year stem forces a Jia Zi-month stem (drain). A water hour stem needs an Yin (Ren) or Mao (Gui) hour branch, excluded by channel 1. Hence no real Ren chart satisfies all eight conditions -- witnessed on the no-peer face by case tj0112-s2-water-near-miss-ren-no-visible-peer, where exactly that one condition fails.
